# Alloy Personal Training Buckhead

> Members-only small-group personal training in Buckhead, Atlanta. 50-minute coach-led sessions customized for every fitness level — strength for every decade.

- Address: 3330 Piedmont Road, Suite 24, Atlanta, GA 30305 (Buckhead, Atlanta)
- Phone / text: 762-245-4442
- Complimentary first session (by appointment): goal setting, health and injury history, a short eating-habits conversation, an InBody body composition scan with protein goals, a functional movement screen and a short sample workout. InBody scans are not offered to walk-ins: https://alloybuckhead.com/free-first-session-inbody-scan-buckhead/
- Book: https://alloybuckhead.com/book
- Sessions: about 50 minutes, coach-led, small groups, customized to each member's fitness level
- Members-only studio, capped at 150 members
- Serves busy professionals, moms and active adults of all ages, especially 35-80
